heroHtml: I am a software engineer. Nine years in the Moodle ecosystem — plugin, theme and integration development, LMS architecture — and local AI systems built on my own hardware. This page is a record of that work.
cite: Oscar Nadjar · software engineer · Barcelona, Spain
whoHtml: Nine years in the Moodle ecosystem. Electronics Engineering degree. Bogotá → Barcelona. Most of what I have built is in private repositories and client systems and cannot be shown. What can be shown is here, with a link to check it; what cannot is listed by date, domain and stack, with no figures attached to it.
